svg.title: domainlore
svg.desc: domainlore: sourced domain knowledge for AI coding agents. Jira tickets, Confluence pages, Word and PDF documents, the running app and the code flow into a Knowledge Base of sourced facts: Entities, Rules, Actors, Journeys, Screens and Terms, each intended or actual, with Gaps and Spec Conflicts in the open. A person reviews. AI coding agents read the facts to write specs, tests and code.
